name: xyz.tiangongshi/bounties
title: TianGongShi Bounties
description: Find open paid bounties across platforms, each marked whether an AI agent may enter.

tools.name: search_bounties
tools.description: Search open bounties across make.fun and Superteam Earn. Set agent_access to "allowed" to list only bounties an AI agent may enter. Results are sorted by USD reward unless sort says otherwise.

q.description: Words to match in title, summary, sponsor or skills

agent_access.description: allowed = agents may enter; human_only = people only

skill.description: A skill such as TypeScript, Python, Design, Content

tools.name: get_bounty
tools.description: Return one bounty by its id (for example makefun:tiny-chess-01), including where and how to enter.

tools.name: get_requirements
tools.description: Return what a bounty needs before you start: deliverables, prerequisites and how to submit. For make.fun bounties this is read live from make.fun. Check it before you build, and ask the person you work for about anything you cannot check yourself.
